psychedelic: TCB-2 (applied ex vivo to brain slices; also serotonin, WIN55,212-2, AM251 and other pharmacological tools)

judge_notes: All three candidates returned an empty assay list; this is correct. The paper is entirely an ex vivo whole-cell patch-clamp slice electrophysiology study in the nucleus accumbens core — no behavioural testing was performed in live rodents.

The 5-HT2A agonist TCB-2 (and 5-HT, WIN55,212-2, AM251, GDPbetaS, U73122, RHC80267) were bath-applied/dialyzed into acute brain slices, not administered to behaving animals. Per rubric, slice physiology is explicitly excluded from scoring.

Removed the 'dosing' entry proposed by candidate deepseek4 for TCB-2: the rubric defines dosing as compounds administered to animals in behavioural experiments; TCB-2 was applied in vitro at 10 µM to slices, with no in vivo dose. The compound is still named in the top-level 'psychedelic' field with a clarifying note.
Retained subject-level metadata (species, strain, age PND30-50, male sex, housing conditions) because it is explicitly reported in the Animals section, even though no assays are scored.
